case_title: J. GORDY VS. CAROL HOLCOMB et al

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - NON-VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF GORDY, J. AS TO DEFENDANT HOLCOMB, CAROL DOES 1-100 SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR APR-20-2007 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  JAN-16-2007 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         APR-05-2007
APPLICATION PENDING FOR WAIVER OF 985.(I) CRC COURT FEES AND COSTS (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF GORDY, J.
HEARING ORDERED FOR APPLICATION OF WAIVER OF COURT FEES, PROOF OF SERVICE FILED BY PLAINTIFF GORDY, J. HEARING SET FOR JAN-03-2007 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 206

HEARING ON APPLICANT/PLAINTIFF J. GORDY'S WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS. NO APPEARANCE BY APPLICANT. THE COURT BEING UNABLE TO EXAMINE APPLICANT RULED ON THE APPLICATION SUBMITTED. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE APPLICANT'S INCOME IS ENOUGH TO PAY THE COMMON NECCESARIES OF LIFE AND COURT FEES AND COSTS. J. GORDY HAS TEN DAYS TO PAY THE FILING FEES OR THE FILINGS WILL BE STRICKEN. ORDER DENYING WAIVER OF FEE SENT TO ALL PARTIES. JUDGE: A JAMES ROBERTSON, III; CLERKS: DLOK/VMU; REPORTER: GENA EALES CSR 	176 (206)
ORDER DENYING WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO CRC 3.50 - 3.63 AS TO PLAINTIFF GORDY, J.
FEES NOT PAID. FILINGS OF J. GORDY ARE STRICKEN. NOTICE SENT TO PARTIES.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR JUN-04-2007 IN DEPARTMENT 212 AT 1:30 PM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE APR-20-2007 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE OF JUN-04-2007 IS OFF CALENDAR, COMPLAINT STRICKEN PER JAN-17-2007 ORDER. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
